newsitem.title: FINLAND: Hackman buoyed by Hintikka appointment.
newsitem.headline: Hackman buoyed by Hintikka appointment.

text.p: Shares in Finnish consumer goods group Oy Hackman Ab gained on Monday, buoyed by news that Nokia Oy executive board member Tapio Hintikka had been named Hackman managing director, brokers said.
At 1635/1435 GMT, Hackman traded at a six-week high 125.00 markka, up 7.00 markka or almost six percent. Trade was 1.5 million markka, which is quite active for Hackman.
Hintikka, resigning president of telecommunications group Nokia's General Communications Products division, will replace Curt Lindbom, who announced his resignation on October 4.
Nokia's share did not move on the news Hintikka was leaving the company. At 1635/1435 GMT, Nokia A traded at 256.00 markka, down 0.50 markka on last Friday's close in Helsinki.
